headline: Supermicro pre-announces Q1: revenue ~$19B vs $15B guided, gross margin 12.0-12.5% vs 10.4-10.8%
reasoning: Primary source: 8-K item 2.02 accepted 20:44 UTC (16:44 ET), Exhibit 99.1 'Supermicro Provides First Quarter of Fiscal Year 2027 Preliminary Business Update'. Benzinga's first headline was 20:42 UTC, two minutes earlier, so the filing was not late. Tonight's case item is a 22:02 UTC rewrite of the same news.

Quoted: 'Revenues for the first quarter of fiscal year 2027 are estimated to be in the range of $18.5 billion to $19.5 billion versus guidance of $14.5 billion to $15.5 billion, primarily due to increased demand for AI platforms.'
Quoted: 'Gross margins are estimated to be in the range of 12.0% to 12.5%, versus guidance of 10.4% to 10.8%, primarily due to customer and product mix.'

Caveat, quoted: 'the Company's independent registered public accounting firm has not audited, reviewed, compiled or performed any procedures with respect to the preliminary revenues and gross margins'. Full results and the call come November 3.

What changed: at the midpoints, quarterly gross profit is about $2.33B ($19.0B x 12.25%) against about $1.59B implied by guidance ($15.0B x 10.6%), roughly 46% more. Consensus revenue was $14.92B per Benzinga.
Price: IEX after hours peaked at 37.15 (+14.4%) and was 36.00 (+10.9% vs the 32.46 close) by 16:55 ET, on 15,747 shares. IEX's after-hours session ends at 17:00 ET, so nothing later is visible.
objections: Preliminary and unaudited; final numbers on Nov 3 may differ.
We saw only 13 minutes of after-hours trade; the overnight level is unknown.
